# unseal.link

> A minimal paywall platform. Sellers paste any link, set a price, and share a paywall URL. Buyers pay via Stripe and receive email-based access. No storefront, no platform lock-in.

## What it does

- Sellers paste any URL (Notion, Figma, Google Drive, GitHub, Discord, Airtable, Loom, etc.)
- Set a price ($9.99 minimum)
- Get a shareable paywall at unseal.link/@username/slug
- Buyers pay via Stripe Checkout and receive an access link by email
- One-time access, no buyer account required
- Sellers keep 95.5% (4.5% platform fee, no monthly costs)
- Payment happens before delivery -- eliminates ghosting for freelancers

## Pricing

- Platform fee: 4.5% per sale
- Stripe processing: ~2.9% + $0.30 per transaction (separate, billed by Stripe)
- No monthly fees, no setup costs, no contracts
- Compared to: Gumroad (10%), Payhip (5%), Lemon Squeezy (5%)

## Technical

- Built with Next.js 15 App Router, Supabase, Stripe Connect Express, Resend
- No content is hosted -- platform controls access, sellers own their content
- Purchases are immutable snapshots (delivery URL captured at purchase time)
- Stripe is the source of truth for payouts
- Buyer auth via HMAC-signed tokens (no Supabase session for buyers)
